messages:
maya: Heads-up — I see ~3k tokens missing from invoices for acct ACCT-229 over the last 24h. Likely delayed metering ingestion. Opening thread to track corrections and owners.
chris: Thanks @maya. I can take the ingestion pipeline fix. Do we have an idea if the ledger accepts retro updates or do we need invoice adjustments?
olivia: Finance here — if tokens were missed and invoices already ran we need invoice corrections + credit memos. Need final counts before EOD to start credits.
jamal: We have a backfill job queued but it needs idempotency guards. I'll write a safe backfill script that verifies sequence IDs before re-ingesting.
chris: Quick plan: 1) patch meter-ingest to avoid the gap (hotfix) 2) run backfill with dry-run checks 3) if counts match, trigger ledger corrections. ETA for hotfix: ~3-4h.
maya: I can compile the affected account list and double-check spike patterns.
billing-bot: Automated notice: Invoice processing completed for 2026-06-15. If retro adjustments are required, open ticket with tag #billing-corrections.
olivia: Opening ticket now — will use the billing-corrections tag and include provisional impact numbers.
jamal: Pushing draft backfill script snippet below for review:
```
# safe backfill pseudo
for batch in batches:
  if not ledger.has_entry(batch.checksum):
    ledger.write(batch)
  else:
    log("skip duplicate", batch.id)
```
chris: Ran hotfix on ingest; logs show no new drops in the last 30m. dropping debug: `ingest.monitor.drops=0`
chris: I'm going to kick off a dry-run backfill against staging counts first, then prod with rate limit.
jamal: Dry-run matched ~2k tokens. Prod run in progress for remaining ~1k — will update when complete. Creating runbook entry for this class of failure.
olivia: Noted. I've drafted customer-facing credit language and will wait for final counts.
sre-lead: Please add a recurring audit: weekly token-consistency check across meter and ledger. Also add alert when ingestion lag >30m for any customer.
maya: Uploaded affected_accounts_ACCT-229.csv to internal drive: https://internal.redwood/drive/affected_accounts_ACCT-229.csv — includes per-customer delta.
jamal: Backfill completed for all accounts in the CSV. Generated reconciliation summary and attached counts. Preparing invoice correction ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INV-4921 (estimated processing window 48h).
chris: Verified post-backfill metrics — ledger token delta within expected tolerance. `ledger_delta=0` for ACCT-229.
olivia: I'll issue credit memos for impacted customers tomorrow morning and include note about the correction. Will tag legal if any contracts with strict billing clauses are affected.
maya: Thanks team. Action items recap (from thread):
- chris — hotfix applied + prod backfill (done)
- jamal — backfill script + runbook + reconciliation output (done)
- olivia — draft & send credit memos, open invoice correction ticket (in progress)
- maya — compiled affected accounts CSV (done)
- sre-lead — set recurring audit and lag alert (action)
Please comment if any ETAs change. :thumbsup:
olivia: FYI I'll mark this thread resolved when INV-4921 is processed and credits are sent.
